versions.changelog: Added explicit startup parameters, required inputs, recommended enterprise UAT inputs, and missing-parameter handling rules; verified standard Skill structure and privacy safety.
Chinese primary sanitized release: converted public guidance to Chinese while preserving abstract privacy-safe enterprise Web UAT methodology.
Sanitized public release: removed project-specific examples, local-machine paths, and current-project business terms; converted to abstract privacy-safe enterprise web UAT guidance.

Initial release of enterprise-web-uat skill for rigorous enterprise web UAT workflows.

- Provides a structured, auditable process for professional web UAT, focusing on alignment with manuals, business documents, and acceptance reporting.
- Enforces a non-negotiable, multi-stage orchestration covering intake, acceptance baseline, business mapping, RTM, case design, execution, evidence, reporting, and packaging.
- Includes dedicated standards for UAT testing, acceptance, and delivery/reporting, with strict rules on audit and remediation.
- Specializes in SaaS/admin portal coverage with a branch model for multi-tenant, multi-role, configuration-driven UI systems.
- Details requirements for UAT cases, traceability, evidence, report structure, and role-based login state management.
